units.function: Embedded-PostgreSQL HTTP tests for projecting a scheduled retry and manually promoting the existing retry Run now, with tenant/actor authorization, idempotent responses and normal execution-gate containment.
units.dependencyDirection: Supertest/Express -> Issue routes and error middleware -> Issue/heartbeat services -> Drizzle/PostgreSQL Issues, Agents, Runs, wake requests, relations, tree holds, comments and activity.
units.keyDataModels: Failed source Run; scheduled retry Run with retryOf/attempt/reason/time and wake request; Issue execution lock/read-model scheduledRetry; board/Agent principals; gate error code; retry-now activity receipt.
units.lifecycle: Create bounded scheduled retry -> expose it on Issue -> board requests retry-now -> atomically expected to promote the same Run or return already/no-op; reevaluate current execution gates -> queue or cancel with reason and activity.
units.testAssessment: All 12 tests skipped in sandboxed and approved unsandboxed runs because embedded PostgreSQL was unavailable. Intended coverage spans projection, sequential duplicate clicks, no-op/already state, paused/budget/review/hold/dependency/terminal gates, Agent rejection and cross-tenant concealment. Missing are concurrent promotion, transaction/outbox crash windows, delivery acknowledgement, stale link/lock corruption, clock races, role matrix, audit completeness and recovery after gate-suppressed cancellation.
units.designRationale: Let a board operator accelerate an already bounded retry without minting duplicate Runs, while reusing current safety and liveness gates and preventing cross-tenant discovery.
units.companyOsProblem: Agent Boss needs an explainable RetryNow control that cannot bypass approval, data, budget or responsibility policy and must preserve exactly-once logical execution across cloud and local nodes.
units.companyOsFit: ADAPT existing-attempt promotion, uniform tenant concealment, explicit outcomes and current-state gate reevaluation. Implement a tenant-scoped compare-and-swap RetryAttempt with idempotency key/fencing token, transactional outbox, Connector acknowledgement and immutable actor/policy/gate receipt; keep suppressed attempts resumable or superseded rather than silently terminal unless policy explicitly requires cancellation.
units.responsibilityConflict: Board access is coarse and not bound to a responsible human, role/certification or exact Work contract. A gate failure turns the scheduled retry into cancelled, but tests do not prove a responsible human is notified or that recoverable work remains discoverable and restartable.
units.securityFindings: CRITICAL distributed-consistency gap for Company OS: no concurrent/multi-instance CAS, transactional outbox or delivery-receipt test. HIGH responsibility gap: board membership is not sufficient proof of accountable authority. HIGH recovery gap: gate suppression cancels the scheduled attempt without tested reactivation/escalation. HIGH verification gap: all real-database/HTTP tests skipped. MEDIUM authorization gap: no viewer/editor/admin matrix. POSITIVE: uniform cross-tenant 404, Agent denial, current-state gates and reuse of one retry Run materially reduce obvious bypass and duplication risks.
